Allegro.eu (WSE:ALE)

Overview: Allegro.eu runs a large online marketplace across Central Europe, linking consumers, merchants, payments, logistics and price comparison in one commerce ecosystem.

Operations: Allegro generates about PLN 11.4b from its Allegro segment and PLN 0.6b from Allegro International, with most revenue sourced in Poland.

Market Cap: PLN 49.8b

data.title: Should AI Partnership Require Action From OpenText Stock Investors?
data.description:
• OpenText Corporation recently announced a partnership with Cohere Inc. to combine OpenText's data and context layer with Cohere's North agentic AI platform for governments and highly regulated sectors, with deployment options across on-premises, private, public, and sovereign clouds.
  • The agreement connects OpenText's broad footprint in federal governments, healthcare, finance, and supply chains directly into agentic AI workflows, which could influence how the business monetizes its existing information management stack in tightly regulated environments.
  • We will now examine how OpenText's investment narrative could be affected by this agentic AI collaboration focused on regulated industries.

Scan how the Open Text AI partnership fits into a wider shift toward regulated-sector automation by lining up potential peers in 89 AI infrastructure stocks.

Open Text Investment Narrative Recap

To own Open Text, an investor needs to believe it can keep shifting its information management base toward cloud, AI and automation while managing gradual erosion in older maintenance contracts. The big near term swing factor remains execution on that cloud and AI mix, especially as earnings are expected to edge slightly lower over the next few years.

The key risk stays the same. If newer offerings, including agentic AI, do not offset pressure in legacy and weaker units such as cybersecurity, overall revenue and margins could be affected. Restructuring and debt coverage also matter, since missteps in those areas could weigh on cash flow while the business optimizes.

The Cohere partnership sits closest to Open Text’s AI and automation push, which analysts already associate with higher per customer spend and better pipeline conversion. It fits directly into that thesis by pairing Open Text’s data layer with Cohere’s North platform for complex workflows in regulated settings.

What matters operationally is whether this agentic AI stack deepens Open Text’s role inside governments, healthcare and finance, where it already runs core systems. Stronger adoption could support the cloud centric catalysts that analysts highlight. Slow traction would leave the existing risks around legacy decline, restructuring and modest earnings expectations more exposed.

Open Text's narrative projects $5.2b revenue and $638.3 million earnings by 2029. This implies relatively flat yearly revenue trends and a decrease of about $4.7 million in earnings from $643.0 million today.
